tonight.headline: Jacobs left in the first quarter — a coin flip on Golden and Gay
body: Bad news first: Josh Jacobs hurt his hand when it caught a facemask in the first quarter at New England and is questionable to return after 4 carries for 5 yards (NBC 21:56Z; Athlon 21:56Z; still questionable per DK Network 22:10Z). Pierre Strong Jr. took his carries. Patrick Mahomes hurt his throwing elbow before half-time and returned; imaging is expected Monday (Athlon). George Pickens was inactive (shoulder, hamstring) and Garrett Wilson out — both on your bench.

Bloodsports trail Jackrabbits 92.16 to 102.82; ESPN projects 123.6 to 124.1, a 49% chance. Every starter is locked — the FLEX (Tuten) and the TE (Likely) are already played, so Loveland cannot come in tonight. Golden (24.6 already) and Gay are what is left; there is nothing to do.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Ashton Jeanty in Jackrabbits' FLEX at San Francisco and Tyler Bass on Monday night are their remaining starters. If Jacobs does not return, your Green Bay pair has to be carried by Golden alone.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Jacobs returns and finishes with a normal workload — then the injury framing here is wrong and the game is the projection's 50-50.

worthALook.name: Seahawks D/ST
worthALook.lead: Now on waivers until Wed 02:00 CDMX, not a free agent — a claim costs priority that never resets.

case.label: The defence
case.body: 97.6% owned across ESPN; Team 13 dropped it at 07:47Z on 6 Nov. Its game against Arizona kicked off at 15:25 CDMX, so ESPN moved it to waivers (league file: WAIVERS, clears 11 Nov 08:00Z). Seattle start Drew Lock with Darnold out (quad).

case.label: Why not
case.body: Your Jaguars D/ST is the season's DST1 by ESPN this week. STRATEGY §4 allows IPADE priority only for a starter-level need or a league-winner, never a streamer.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if it clears waivers unclaimed and becomes a free agent on Wednesday — then compare the Week 10 opponents and add it for free if the gap over Jacksonville is real.

worthALook.name: Pierre Strong Jr.
worthALook.lead: Took Jacobs' carries after the hand injury — and he is a free agent, so he costs no priority.

case.label: The player
case.body: Replaced Jacobs after the first-quarter hand injury (ESPN's Demovsky via Athlon 21:56Z); 4 carries for 10 yards at the snapshot (archive). Lloyd inactive with the knee; Brooks was questionable (ankle).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: IPADE already carries Taylor, Gordon, Tuten and Marks behind Jacobs; Strong would not start in Week 10 even if Jacobs sits. Every bench seat is a WR1 with an injury (Wilson, Pickens), a TE2 or a lead back.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If Monday's imaging puts Jacobs out multiple weeks AND Lloyd stays out — then Strong is Green Bay's lead back and worth a free add over Marks only if Montgomery is back for Houston.

doNotChase.name: Brandon Aubrey
doNotChase.lead: Now on waivers after his game kicked off — a 1.2-point kicker edge for a priority that never resets.

case.label: The number
case.body: Aubrey 10.5 projected against Gay's 9.3 this week; Dallas played at 12:00, so ESPN put him on waivers (clears Wed 08:00Z).

case.label: Why not
case.body: STRATEGY §4-5: never spend IPADE priority on a streamer, and a stream that gains about a point costs a move for nothing.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Gay injured or released, or Aubrey clearing waivers to free agency with a Week 10 projection 2+ points above Gay.
